title: Flipped Classroom Videos From the Slides You Already Have (blog explainer)

brief.story: A clear explainer of the post.

slides.title: Flipped Classroom Videos From Your Slides
slides.notes: Flipping your class? You don't need a studio. The lecture slides you already have can become short pre-class videos your students will actually watch.

slides.title: Your Slides Are Already the Raw Material
slides.notes: Your slides are already sequenced and matched to the learning outcomes. As videos, they let students pause and rewatch, read captions, and hear the same explanation.

slides.title: Plan Short Videos, Not Recorded Lectures
bullets: Name the class activity for each
slides.notes: Split each lecture into one-concept chunks. A week on supply and demand becomes four short videos. For each one, name what students will do in class.

slides.title: Trim Slides, Write Notes for the Ear
bullets: End with a link to class
slides.notes: Keep the slide for the key idea and move explanations into the notes. Your notes become the narration, so write them for the ear and link them to class.

slides.title: Put Videos Beside the Activity
bullets: Upload to Moodle, Canvas or Blackboard
Before class: two or three short videos
slides.notes: Place each video in your LMS right next to the activity that depends on it, and tell students the total viewing time up front.

slides.title: Start With One Week
bullets: Make two or three short videos
slides.notes: Start with one week. On Pro, a.i. directs your lecture deck into a produced explainer, or try Basic first. Ordinary slides in, extraordinary video out at powerpoint2vid.com.
